## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_伤官 (Water carrying The Virtuoso). Persona The Virtuoso (伤官). Definition line: "Cross-current output, brilliance made of what it meets". Keyword Brilliance, charge fierce, poles catalyst Spark / friction Pushback. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: brilliance against the grain; shining reads as defiance. Arena: the stage, spark, off-script, the note held too long. Classical portrait: brilliance and defiance; output that exceeds its container; 傲物气高, cannot hold its tongue. Ruled domains: Talent, Performance, Defiance. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 食神.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal generating Water cross-polarity — precision producing depth that exceeds its container".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Virtuoso: a current too clever for its banks. You express in floods of insight, subversive, fluid, impossible to police, the writer between the lines, the wit that erodes pomposity by morning. Nothing contains you long. The art is choosing what your torrent carves next."
- k2_functional: "Your expression flows subversive and quotable, satire and insight braided into one current."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Silver-tongued","Inspired","Free-flowing"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Talent":"Your talent is fluid genius: writing, strategy, humor, any craft where thought must flow around form. It resists containers and needs them. Choose loose ones, essays, seasons, series, and pour.","Performance":"You perform by currents: the essay that spreads, the remark that travels. Your stage is wherever words flow. Publish more, polish less. Rivers are judged by movement, not by stillness.","Defiance":"Your defiance dissolves things: authority mocked into smallness, rules outlived rather than fought. It is elegant and it accumulates enemies slowly. Now and then, defend something openly. It sweetens the water."}

value.text: Whatever you are thinking is already on its way out, and the editing happens after. There is more Water in you than you take time to settle, so you say the thought ahead of deciding whether it is yours to say. Keep in mind that you do not owe every true thing a hearing.

value_b.text: Holding a thought in costs you more than saying it ever has, so out it goes. Being fully known matters to you ahead of being careful, which puts the story out before you have told the person it is about. Remember that you get to keep a few things until you have finished them.

value.text: The joke with a bite in it is your first language, and plain praise comes out like a foreign one. Since being clever feels safer than being seen caring, you reach for the dry line instead of the warm one. Do not forget that you mean the warm one more than it sounds.

value_b.text: Making fun of a thing is how you get close to it, and you give the people you love the most of it. You tease rather than say what you feel outright, so your affection arrives disguised as a dig. Remember that you hear the fondness underneath more clearly than anyone you aim it at.

value.text: Breaking an unexplained rule starts before you have decided to, and you are proud of that. Since being told what to do feels like being made smaller, you push back ahead of asking whether the rule had a point. It is worth remembering that you pick the fight more than it picks you.

value_b.text: Pushing back is the first thing you do with any instruction, before you have read it to the end. You take being free ahead of being right, so you end up arguing with the ones you agree with. Remember that you spend more on the fight than the rule was ever worth.

value.text: Arguing with whoever is in charge is your form of honesty, and you prefer an audience for it. Because you make the point rather than let the person above you keep their footing, you cost them the standing their job depends on. Remember that you could disagree in private first and lose nothing.
